pull_request.title: Calorimeter: draw the HCAL barrel sector in transverse section
pull_request.head: codex/hcal-barrel-sector-xy
pull_request.body:
Adds the requested x–y view of the implemented HCAL barrel sector: a true z=0 cut of sector0 centred on+x, with all60sampling layers and an equal-scale front-five-layer detail.

![HCAL barrel sector](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/hcal-barrel-sector-xy/docs/validation/hcal50/barrel-xy/hcal-barrel-sector-xy.png?raw=true)

The drawing uses the actual exported sector placements and original common-unit solids/cuts. It retains the real carrier shifts, individual scintillator cores, board seams, supports, PCB/copper and cooling. White regions are air or actual gaps. The cut contains241carriers and2892core sections; it does not project all47axial rows into one image. Circular tube outlines are polygonized for rendering only.

Includes PNG, vector PDF, source/render hashes and a reproduction script. Geometry assertions confirm all60steel layers,3130/5720mm face apothems,2590mm depth and the intersected-row counts. Visually inspected; label collisions fixed. No geometry, material, simulation or physics-result changes; no native run required. Existing Matplotlib environment, no new dependencies.

Task TASK-HCAL-SECTOR-XY, design DES-045. Stacked onPR155 to retain the implemented HCAL source. Draft only under the standing AGENTS.md publication instruction; no sign-off, ready-for-review action or merge.

User, exact: “Can you give me an x-y view of the HCAL barrel sector ?”

Created a true z=0 transverse section of the implemented DES045 sector0 centred on+x, with a full60-layer view and equal-scale front-five-layer detail. It uses actual exported trapezoids, carrier placements and original common-unit box/tube/CSG shapes. Radial/tangential packing, axial layer shifts, board/core gaps and all intersecting passive parts are retained. One axial row per layer intersects this cut; it contains241carriers/2892individual core sections. All60steel plates and3130/5720mm face apothems agree with source.
